## Description

Use recurrent networks to learn temporal dependencies from price/feature sequences.

## Where it may fit

Large, well-curated sequence datasets with stable feature/label generation.

## Vehicles

Quant research, ETF allocation, FX/crypto and liquid futures.

## Required data

Time-indexed price/volume and optional macro/fundamental sequences; training/validation splits and execution costs.

## Caveats

Often fragile on financial data; assess calibration and net trading utility, not just prediction loss.
